change.summary: Legacy media playback warnings are now emitted only for the same media-v1 profile that the server publication validator enforces. This keeps the Inspector from promising a Publish rejection on historical unversioned documents, whose existing behavior remains compatible.
rules: media-v1 audio with controls=false is rejected at Publish, but can still be saved as a repairable draft
media-v1 video controls=false is allowed only for muted autoplay background video
unversioned historical media keeps its existing server behavior and receives no media-v1-only warning
